summary: iter88 — Dashboard Hub new features (admin-message-user prefill, scout-message email alarm, trial application interest, live library counts). Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS at /app/backend/tests/test_iter88_dashboard_hub_new.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter88.xml). Covered: POST /api/dashboard/opportunities/{id}/interest as admin -> {ok,interested:true} + idempotent on re-apply (still exactly 1 applicant on seed opp for admin email), GET /api/dashboard/opportunities item includes interested:true, DELETE withdraws (applicant count 0 after), free-user POST -> 403 (message: 'Trials & opportunities are a Premium feature'), unknown opp_id -> 404. Admin: GET /api/admin/dashboard/opportunities returns interest_count per item, GET /api/admin/dashboard/opportunities/{id}/interest returns applicants w/ user_name+user_email+created_at, both endpoints 401/403 without admin. Cascade delete verified in mongo (temp opp created + applied + deleted -> dashboard_opportunity_interest count == 0). Community: GET /api/admin/dashboard/community returns live_players_in_library=1 + live_players_wk=1 (matches known 1 discoverable user), PUT use_live_players:true persists (verified via user GET returning live count), then PUT use_live_players:false + players_in_library:2847 restores manual number. Email alarm: kind=message+sender_type=scout+target_email=<premium disposable> -> 'message alert emails sent' log line observed in backend.err.log; kind=notification (same sender_type/target) -> no new log line; kind=message+sender_type=admin -> no new log line; target=free -> no new log line (0 recipients as per _alert_recipient_emails). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080 admin session): /admin Users tab has 6 admin-message-user-{id} mail icons; clicking first switches to Player Dashboard tab and composer-target-email input is prefilled with that user's email ('dkdkf@gmail.con'). DashboardHubAdmin community-live-count line reads 'Live right now: 1 discoverable player (real) · +1 this week'; community-use-live-toggle checkbox + community-save-btn persist toggle=true (verified via API GET /admin/dashboard/community after reload returned use_live_players:true). /dashboard opportunities-panel row shows opportunity-interest-{id} 'I'm interested' -> after click toast + button text becomes 'Interested'; /admin Player Dashboard opp-applicants-{id} pill reads '1 interested', clicking expands opp-applicant-list-{id} containing 'Elite Scout Admin admin@elitescout.com <timestamp>'; withdraw click reverts button to 'I'm interested' with toast 'Interest withdrawn.'. All disposable data cleaned; seed opportunity 'Elite Football Academy Trials' has zero interest records; seed message 'Impressive footage' (78a7dbfb...) intact; community setting reset to use_live_players=false + players_in_library=2847.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard_hub.py grew to 589 lines and is close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (messages/, opportunities/, community/, emails/) before adding more features.

_alert_recipient_emails does a full users.find scan (up to 500) plus a reports.distinct — add mongo indexes on users.subscription.status and reports.is_paid/manually_unlocked for scale; for now list is capped at 500 which silently truncates the audience — worth logging when the cap is hit.
opportunity_interest_withdraw returns 200 even when no doc existed (no 404 for 'not applied'). Consistent with idempotent style but worth documenting.

dashboard_opportunity_interest has no unique compound index on (user_id, opportunity_id) — the upsert handles idempotency logically but a unique index would guarantee it at the db level and speed up admin aggregation.

AdminPage.jsx composerPrefill useEffect in DashboardHubAdmin needs to guard against clearing user input if admin manually edits target_email then clicks another mail icon — currently prefill fully overwrites (acceptable UX but worth noting).

OpportunitiesPanel.jsx uses window.location or similar to refetch after interest toggle — after clicking withdraw, the list should ideally also update the local interest_count if displayed anywhere; currently only the button state is updated (fine, no count displayed on user side).
server.py still 14k+ lines — extract _notify_dashboard_report + premium helpers into a shared module.

success_rate.frontend: 100% flows verified (prefill, live-count display, toggle persistence via API, interest apply/withdraw, applicant pill+list)

test_credentials: admin@elitescout.com / Admin@2026!Elite. Disposable users created via direct db insert with server.hash_password to bypass /api/auth/signup 429 rate limit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter88_dashboard_hub_new.py — creates disposable free + premium-simulated users via direct mongo insert, exercises all interest endpoints (including cascade delete + free-403 + 404), community live-count toggle + revert, and the 4 email-alarm branches (scout=fire, notification-kind=no, admin-sender=no, target-free=no), with autouse module fixture teardown restoring community to use_live_players=false/players_in_library=2847 and deleting all disposable data. Together with iter86 + iter87 files it now covers the full Dashboard Hub API surface. Note there is currently 1 real user with discoverable=true in preview DB (live count = 1, +1 this week).
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work end-to-end.
